requirements.description: Energy class C or better (A1 through C). Only the energy_class column is used because energy_score_class cannot separate C from D and E. The square-meter, capacity, funding-program, and public-transport requirements are outside the energy scope and are not included.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The planned future use (student residence), the 60-person capacity, the energy class, and public transport access are not converted into filters: capacity has no verified regulatory area threshold, and energy class and transport proximity are not reference columns.

The user explicitly wants a location near public transport. Per the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71), the property should be within the top quartile of transport accessibility.

The property will serve as a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is clearly necessary. Per the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75), the property should be in the top quartile of education accessibility.

Results are ordered by distance to that point, nearest first. Predicates are ordered strictest to softest.
